rationale: The original thesis relied on a bounce off the confluence of session VWAP and the 5-minute 9-EMA at $13.86, as well as holding above the $13.84 pullback low. Price has now broken below both the 5-minute 9-EMA ($13.90) and session VWAP ($13.86) on expanding downside volume across the last two 1-minute candles (9,837 and 13,101 shares), violating the $13.84 support level at $13.83. While the broader market remains strongly risk-on (SPY +1.94%), the breakdown in VIR's intraday structure negates the long setup without offering a high-probability short against the strong market regime, making an immediate exit the optimal choice.
